Name: Spam Mail Expansion - MakoKZ
Author: MarsJenkar
Description:
This mod is an expansion to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/atravita?gameId=1303]atravita[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17786]Spam Mail[/url]﻿ mod.  It adds the additional letters from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22765]Mako's Spam Mail[/url] to the random mail you can receive.

[b][u]Why use this and not Mako's Spam Mail?[/u][/b]

Mako's Spam Mail uses deprecated code, for one thing.  Also, the way the mail is randomly generated in Mako's mod, there's nothing stopping a whole bunch of spam from landing in your mailbox all at once, which also means that the new mail messages run out fairly quickly.  By using atravita's code, the messages are spread out according to the anticipated length of the game--longer games mean longer times between messages.

[b][u]Will the random rewards still be included?[/u][/b]

Yes.  The letters which had rewards in the original will still have them in this mod.

[b][u]Are the letters the exact same?[/u][/b]

For the most part.  I did slightly alter the "Splash Park" letter to make it a follow-up to atravita's "AquaThrills" letter.  It even triggers follow-up dialogue from Jodi.

[b][u]Wait, dialogue?  That's new.[/u][/b]

Yes indeed!  Some of the letters you receive will now trigger dialogue from some of the villagers.  Not all letters will trigger dialogue, and it's not always apparent who will have something to say.  This was a feature of atravita's mod that I wanted to include here.

[b][u]Are the ominous mail messages still included?[/u][/b]

Ominous mail is still included, and is still optional.  Three of the four messages are now designed to appear spread out over time.

[b][u]What about the custom mail backgrounds?[/u][/b]

Those are also included with this mod.  Credit to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/MakoKZ?gameId=1303]MakoKZ[/url] for the original images.

[b][u]Why does this mod have an "Expected Play Time" config value like atravita's mod does?[/u][/b]

Unfortunately I'm new to mod-making for Stardew Valley, and I don't know how to pull a value from another mod's configuration and use it for this mod.  So I added the value again to this mod file.  Please use the same value for both.

[b][u]I found a bug![/u][/b]

Thanks!  Please post your issue to the Bugs tab for this mod.  I want to make sure this mod works properly for all users, and bug reports are an important part of that process.
